Cast iron skillet 26 cm

A heavy, pre-seasoned skillet that goes from stovetop to oven to table. The thick walls hold heat evenly, so a steak gets a deep crust and cornbread comes out golden at the edges.

Wash it by hand with warm water, dry it on the stove and rub in a few drops of oil. With that small habit the seasoning gets better with every meal instead of wearing off.

  • Diameter 26 cm
  • Weight 2.4 kg
  • Works on gas, electric, induction and open fire
